name: new_bank_v2_song_250hz_exploratory
source: user-supplied Song HDF5 v3 eight-channel sessions on 2026-09-18
preprocessing: existing continuous-session causal 40 Hz highpass and 50/100 Hz notch; fixed 50-sample windows; no target-fitted filter state

family_parameters.F0v2: six local measures per channel; noise thresholds fitted from source neutral only
family_parameters.F2a: centered covariance, fixed 0.05 shrinkage, trace normalized
family_parameters.F3c: four circular covariance lags, five statistics each; no half-window drift under 100 samples

classifier: source-window StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
score_unit: one probability vector per formal native trial by mean of its available window probabilities
selection_rule: Select among v2 arms by S03 trial macro-F1, tie by log loss, then listed order. S04 was examined in earlier studies, so all S04 results remain exploratory and cannot support an independent final claim.
reference_check: Reproduce prior new_bank_v1 legacy F0 probabilities for all S03/S04 held-out trials to within 1e-10
scope: One person, four same-day sessions, offline cue-labelled stable intervals; no new-day, electrode re-placement, force, online onset or live latency claim
